none: PAS BM-E098CA: BM-E098CA: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is oval in plan and hemispherical in section. The flat upper surface of the sealing possesses an oval field within which there appears to be a figurative scene (possibly two figures or a single figure and building?) above a legend in relief which reads [...]VO[...].
